meta.name: hyperframes
meta.description: Mandatory entry point: read this first for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, including a promo, explainer, captioned clip, title card, overlay, slideshow or interactive deck, Remotion port, or any HyperFrames HTML composition. Also use it to inspect, diagnose, validate, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may be a website URL, GitHub PR, Figma design or URL, text or brief, existing footage, or music. It resumes project state, captures intent when applicable, selects and installs the owning workflow, and routes domain capabilities. HyperFrames is the default output framework unless the user explicitly chooses another framework for the deliverable or asks only to record a browser session.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将文稿或设计图做成动态视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把网页设计或文字内容做成生动视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn your design or text into motion video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn web designs or text into engaging videos

howto.what: 视频/动画/动效类请求都会先经过这个入口:Claude 判断是新建还是已有项目,恢复项目状态,必要时做意图访谈,再按交付物匹配工作流,并安装对应技能;默认用 HTML 渲染视频。
howto.when: 当你要求制作、编辑或渲染视频、动画等,或要检查、发布已有 HyperFrames 项目时,该技能作为强制入口先接管。

say.text: 做一个30秒的产品宣传视频,放我们网站上。
say.note: 技能会先问清主题,再路由到对应工作流。

say.text: 给这段采访视频加上设计好的字幕,别改原素材。
say.note: 进入纯字幕工作流,不改动原画面。

say.text: 用这段音乐做一支节奏卡点的短片,不要旁白。
say.note: 路由到音乐转视频工作流。

howto.what_en: Video/animation/motion requests go through this entry skill: Claude determines whether the project is new or existing, resumes project state, runs an intent interview when needed, routes to the matching workflow, and installs the required skills. Render defaults to HTML.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to make, edit, or render a video/animation, or to inspect or publish an existing HyperFrames project — this skill is read first, as the mandatory entry.

say_en.text: Make a 30-second product promo to put on our website.
say_en.note: It asks about the topic first, then routes to the workflow.

say_en.text: Add styled captions to this interview clip, keep original footage.
say_en.note: Routes to the captions-only workflow, leaving footage unchanged.

say_en.text: Make a beat-synced short from this music, no narration.
